items.title: Sculpting semisynthetic conducting protein pores by de novo design.
items.one_liner:
The researchers created semisynthetic conducting protein pores by integrating a de novo‑designed component into the bacterial CsgG nanopore scaffold, yielding pores with programmable architecture and distinct ion‑conduction properties, including rectifying behavior.

METHOD / APPROACH:
They started from the CsgG nanopore scaffold (a known bacterial pore) and added an integral de novo‑designed transmembrane element (likely a β‑barrel or α‑helical barrel) to form hybrid, semisynthetic pores.
